is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife unless licensed to practice that profession.

title_protection.quote: only a person who holds a license to practice professional nursing in this state pursuant to this part 1 or who holds a license in another state and is practicing in this state pursuant to section 24-60-3802 may use the title "registered nurse" and its abbreviation, "R.N."

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice practical or professional nursing or as a certified midwife without an active license issued under this part 1 is subject to penalties pursuant to section 12-20-407 (1)(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has procured or attempted to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under his or her care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice nursing or any other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice nursing, practice as a certified midwife, or practice any other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or aiding or knowingly permitting any person to violate any provision of this part 1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or has aided or knowingly permitted any person to violate any provision of this part 1 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or as a certified midwife in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards for the practice of nursing or as a certified midwife, as applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice, practice as a certified midwife, or licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or negligently making incorrect entries or failing to make essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified or in a negligent manner made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessively or habitually using or abusing alcohol, habit-forming drugs, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessively or habitually uses or abuses or has engaged in excessive or habitual use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or behavioral health disorder affecting ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder that affects the person's ability to practice nursing or as a certified midwife with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the confidentiality of information or knowledge concerning any patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge as prescribed by law concerning any patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that would constitute a crime related to employment as a nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any conduct that would constitute a crime as defined in title 18 and that relates to the person's employment as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating abuse of health insurance provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and repeated ordering or performance of demonstrably unnecessary services without clinical justification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, distributing, or giving controlled substances to oneself or a family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed, distributed, or given to himself or herself or a family member any controlled substance as defined in part 2 of article 18 of title 18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, injecting, or prescribing anabolic steroids for performance enhancement without medical necessity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has dispensed, injected, or prescribed an anabolic steroid, as defined in section 18-18-102 (3), for the purpose of hormonal manipulation that is intended to increase muscle mass, strength, or weight without a medical necessity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing controlled substances other than in the course of legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has administered, dispensed, or prescribed any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by another state, territory, or country for substantially the same conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by another state, territory, or country based upon an act or omission that is defined substantially the same as a ground for discipline pursuant to this subsection (1)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully fails to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-255-119 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to accurately complete and submit the designated questionnaire upon renewal of a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to accurately complete and submit to the board the designated questionnaire upon renewal of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as a licensed nurse or using protected titles without being licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represents oneself to an individual or to the general public by use of any word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that he or she is a licensed practical or professional nurse unless the person is actually licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a nurse during a period when the license has been suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife during a period when the person's license has been suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status pursuant to section 12-255-122

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or fraudulently obtaining or furnishing a license to practice as a nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sells or fraudulently obtains or furnishes a license to practice as a nurse or certified midwife or aids or abets in such act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board within thirty days after a final criminal conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board, within thirty days after a final conviction, that the person has been convicted of a crime, as defined in title 18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain professional liability insurance as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional liability insurance in accordance with section 12-255-113

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during or within six months after the professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the person's professional relationship with the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a final malpractice judgment or settlement within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the board, in writing and within thirty days after a judgment or settlement is entered, of a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction against the licensee for malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board within thirty days after an adverse action by another licensing agency or institution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days after an adverse action, that an adverse action has been taken against the person by another licensing agency in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report the surrender of a license in another jurisdiction while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days, the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice nursing or as a certified midwife in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverting or having diverted a controlled substance from the place of employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is diverting or has diverted a controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or any other drug having similar effects from the person's place of employment

definition_quote.value: The delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings. The functions include the initiation and performance of nursing care through health promotion, supportive or restorative care, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, and physical or mental condition using specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill involving the application of biological, physical, social, and behavioral science principles required for licensure as a professional nurse.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings.

value: Evaluating health status through the collection and assessment of health data
Providing therapy and treatment supportive and restorative to life and well-being
Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions
Referring patients to medical or community agencies
Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans
methods_authorized.quote: The "practice of professional nursing" includes the performance of such services as: Evaluating health status through the collection and assessment of health data; Health teaching and health counseling; Providing therapy and treatment that is supportive and restorative to life and well-being either directly to the patient or indirectly through consultation with, delegation to, supervision of, or teaching of others; Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions; Referring to medical or community agencies those patients who need further evaluation or treatment; Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans.

drug_authority.value: APRNs and certified midwives with prescriptive authority may prescribe controlled substances and prescription drugs within their scope of practice and role/population focus
drug_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife may be granted authority to prescribe prescription drugs and controlled substances to provide treatment to clients within the role and population focus of the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife

license_tiers.quote: A registered professional nurse who is included in the advanced practice registry has the right to use the title "advanced practice registered nurse" or, if authorized by the board, to use the title "certified nurse midwife", "clinical nurse specialist", "certified registered nurse anesthetist", or "nurse practitioner".

aprn_role_categories.quote: "certified nurse midwife", "clinical nurse specialist", "certified registered nurse anesthetist", or "nurse practitioner". These titles may be abbreviated as "A.P.R.N.", "C.N.M.", "C.N.S.", "C.R.N.A.", or "N.P.", respectively.

value: licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of practical nursing" means the performance, under the supervision of a licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall practice in accordance with the standards of the appropriate national professional nursing organization and have a safe mechanism for consultation or collaboration with a physician or, when appropriate, referral to a physician.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: "Practice of advanced practice registered nursing" means an expanded scope of professional nursing in a scope, role, and population focus approved by the board, with or without compensation or personal profit, and includes the practice of professional nursing.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife must obtain seven hundred fifty hours of documented experience in a mutually structured prescribing mentorship

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who obtains prescriptive authority pursuant to this section shall be assigned a specific identifier by the state board of nursing.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: The board may authorize the following licensees to prescribe controlled substances or prescription drugs, as those terms are defined in section 12-280-103

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs with prescriptive authority are subject to the limitations on prescriptions specified in section 12-30-109, including a seven-day supply limit for initial opioid prescriptions to new patients
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife with prescriptive authority pursuant to this section is subject to the limitations on prescriptions specified in section 12-30-109.

dea_registration_required.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.
dea_registration_required.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 30 - Provisions Applicable to Health-Care Profession

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.
controlled_substance_database_registrati.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 30 - Provisions Applicable to Health-Care Profession

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of all certified nurse aides and a record of all final disciplinary action taken against persons under this article 255.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Prior to a certified nurse aide obtaining authority as a medication aide to administer medications, the certified nurse aide shall meet all applicable requirements as established by rules of the board.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Any licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate any task included in the nurse's or certified midwife's licensed scope of practice, subject to the requirements of this section. A licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate nursing or certified midwife tasks to licensed, certified, registered, or unlicensed or unregulated assistive personnel.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: An employer of a medication aide shall report conduct that constitutes grounds for discipline pursuant to this section to the board and any disciplinary action taken by the employer against a medication aide or the resignation of a medication aide in lieu of a disciplinary action resulting from the conduct.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24

multistate_license_option_available.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24
